data.one_liner: Elm-style terminal UI framework for Dart with Model–Update–View architecture.
data.what_it_does: Builds interactive CLI applications and terminal user interfaces using an Elm-style Model–Update–View architecture. Includes async commands, over 27 ready-made components, spring animations, and Lipgloss-inspired styling.
use_when: You want to build a rich, interactive command-line or terminal application in Dart
You prefer an Elm-style state management and rendering flow for your CLI app
avoid_when: You are building a traditional graphical user interface for mobile, web, or desktop
You only need to print basic console output without an interactive event loop
strengths: Rich set of 27+ ready-made components and Lipgloss-inspired styling utilities
Cell-level diff renderer for zero-flicker updates
weaknesses: Limited to terminal and CLI environments
Requires handling terminal control keys and raw mode specifics
